expires.description: Expires is when this resource expires (RFC3339).

labels.description: Labels are arbitrary key/value pairs attached to the resource.

namespace.description: Namespace is the resource namespace (usually left blank).

revision.description: Revision is used for optimistic concurrency control.

spec.description: AutoupdateVersion resource definition v1 from Teleport

mode.description: autoupdate_mode to use for the rollout

schedule.description: schedule to use for the rollout

start_version.description: start_version is the version used for newly installed agents before their update window.

target_version.description: target_version is the version that all agents will update to during their update window.

TargetVersion specifies the semantic version required for tools to establish a connection with the cluster. Client tools after connection to the cluster going to be updated to this version automatically.
